name: Daily notes
description: A note for each day, named by its date, in its folder, made from a template: open today's or tomorrow's from the command palette, or edit one on a dashboard.

format.label: Date format
format.description: the date format daily notes are named in (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD for a folder each month...)

template.label: Template
template.description: a note new daily notes start from, its path without .md (Templates/Daily); none: they start empty

day.description: a day's daily note, edited in place; steps to other days, opens the note, starts a missing one from the template

section.description: a heading (Plan): only its section; left out: the whole note
